title: Google Research Launches Deep Review After 15,000 Research Paper Pilot

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
A new agentic system for critique of design documents and complex proposals is now available to engineers and researchers worldwide. Developed by Google Research, Deep Review stress tests manuscripts and professional papers before they are submitted or published to provide a structured layer of critique.

The tool is being released to the general public following pilot partnerships in which the system analyzed more than 15,000 research papers. The system is designed to help researchers and professionals integrate structured feedback into their daily workflows to improve the quality of their submissions.
